mentions.name: Kuberik
mentions.description: A continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes built on top of Flux and the OpenKruise canary controller. It delivers full-featured, end-to-end deployment across multiple Kubernetes environments in a declarative way without pipeline engines, with each delivery stage implemented as a composable component (health checks, smoke tests, schedules, environment promotions, service dependencies). A recent release adds GitHub integration so users can track exactly what is deployed where and how far a change has progressed.
mentions.problem: Reinventing the wheel with pipeline engines every time something needed to be deployed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
